import requests

def get_protein_info(gene):
    url = "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
    params = {
        "query": f"gene_exact:{gene} AND organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true",
        "fields": "accession,gene_names,protein_name,length,mass,sequence",
        "format": "json",
        "size": 1
    }
    r = requests.get(url, params=params)
    data = r.json()
    if not data.get("results"):
        return None
    res = data["results"][0]
    seq = res.get("sequence", {})
    return {
        "gene": gene,
        "accession": res.get("primaryAccession"),
        "length": seq.get("length"),
        "molWeight_Da": seq.get("molWeight"),
        "molWeight_kDa": seq.get("molWeight", 0)/1000 if seq.get("molWeight") else None,
    }

for g in ["AOAH", "ZNF219"]:
    info = get_protein_info(g)
    print(info)
    print("---")</execute>', "================================== Ai Message ==================================
